data.name: Privacy_FilterEnabled_Description
data.value: When enabled, only messages from whitelisted channels are persisted to the database. Disabling restores upstream ChatTwo behavior (everything except battle messages is stored).

data.name: Privacy_Whitelist_Help
data.value: Pick which channels are stored in the local database. Privacy-First default: only your own conversations. Use the buttons below to apply a preset.

data.name: Privacy_PersistUnknown_Description
data.value: Failsafe for ChatTypes added by future FFXIV patches that this plugin does not yet know about. Default OFF (Privacy-First). Turn ON if you want a complete log including future channels.

data.name: Cleanup_Help_Intro
data.value: The privacy filter only applies to new messages. Use the cleanup below to retroactively remove already-stored messages that don't match your saved whitelist.

data.name: Cleanup_Help_SavedNote
data.value: Cleanup uses your SAVED whitelist (Plugin.Config), not unsaved edits above. Click Save first if you want to apply your current edits.

data.name: Cleanup_NoPreview
data.value: No preview yet. Click Refresh to compute the impact.

data.name: Cleanup_Apply_Tooltip
data.value: Ctrl+Shift: Hard-deletes {0:N0} messages, then runs VACUUM. Cannot be undone.

data.name: Cleanup_PreviewError
data.value: Failed to compute cleanup preview, see /xllog

data.name: Retention_Enabled_Name
data.value: Auto-delete messages after a per-channel retention window

data.name: Retention_Enabled_Description
data.value: When enabled, messages older than the configured window are deleted on every plugin start (at most once per 24 hours). Off by default — the plugin never deletes history without your explicit consent.

data.name: Retention_Default_Help
data.value: Applies to channels without an explicit override below.

data.name: Retention_Apply_Tooltip
data.value: Ctrl+Shift: runs the retention sweep immediately using the SAVED policy. Save your changes first.

data.name: Migration_Notification_Content
data.value: Privacy filter activated by default. Settings → Privacy to adjust.

data.name: Wizard_Intro
data.value: Pick a starting profile. You can change anything later under Settings → Privacy.

data.name: Wizard_Profile_PrivacyFirst_Description
data.value: Only your own conversations are stored: Tells, Party, FC, Linkshells, Cross-World Linkshells, Alliance and ExtraChat. Public chat, NPC dialogue and system spam are dropped at the storage layer. Retention follows the spec defaults (Tells 365 days, own-conversation channels 90 days).

data.name: Wizard_Profile_Casual_Description
data.value: Privacy-First plus a 24-hour window for public chat (Say, Shout, Yell, both emote types, Novice Network). For RP players who want to look up the last scene without keeping public chat forever.

data.name: Wizard_Profile_FullHistory_Description
data.value: Disables the privacy filter entirely. Stores everything except battle logs, just like upstream Chat 2. Retention is OFF, history grows forever.

data.name: Wizard_Profile_FullHistory_GdprWarning
data.value: GDPR notice: storing third-party messages (Say/Shout/Yell of strangers, NPC dialogue with player names, etc.) for an unlimited time may exceed the personal/household exemption (Art. 2(2)(c)). Use this profile only if you have a clear reason to keep the full archive.
